total_supply.meaning: ERC-20 totalSupply value used as scaling factor in share-minting and redemption formulas

ghost_shares.meaning: 1,000,000 shares included in totalSupply that are never minted to any account

sum_balances.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] across all accounts, the backed share total

value_skimmed.meaning: value is stealthily skimmed into the void, permanently disadvantaging honest users

assumptions: The 1,000,000 ghost shares are a literal constructor value included in totalSupply.
Share-minting and redemption formulas scale by totalSupply, so an inflated totalSupply dilutes per-share value.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete numeric expected-versus-actual share or asset amounts for the over-mint/under-pay effects, so the magnitude of value skimmed cannot be quantified.

limitations: The conservation relation is stated at the share-count level (totalSupply vs sum of balances); the permanent value-skimming impact is represented as a Boolean outcome because no numeric asset amounts are reported.
No attacker transaction sequence is described; the flaw is a constructor-time state condition.
